text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, though I had no particular plans,
I was summoned by King Halo to an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehehehehe...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-ho-ho-ho-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she's laughing boastfully, not in her usual uniform or casual clothes, but in her racing silk.
The only logical deduction from this is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No it is nooot! You clod!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Are your head still in the clouds?
Try to remember. Today is my autograph session
here at this amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Prompted by her words, I pull out my planner from my bag and double-check our schedule through the end of this week.
choice_data_list: Um, the autograph session schedule is...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now! Let's hurry to the venue.
We can't keep the fans waiting!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why is there nobody in lineee~~?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even with such a fabulous sign out for the autograph session!
Why?! For what possible reason?!
How could everyone just walk right past it?!
choice_data_list: Hey, were those plans really meant for today?
Hey, were those plans really for today?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's right... You heard about it during the meeting, didn't you? This week's—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the giant sign for the autograph session
with her. The date written on it is—
choice_data_list: I think the autograph session is scheduled for tomorrow

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...So in other words, rather than scouting,
we came to the amusement park
to blow off some steam!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Say something!!
What's the big deal anyway?!
It's just an unexpected day off!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"After all, I'm the top of the top tier,
a super-first-rate talent who conquered a GⅠ regardless of distance, you know?
Besides, it's been a while since either of us took a break, hasn't it?"
choice_data_list: You really accomplished something incredible, huh.
You really accomplished something incredible, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was truly the journey of a King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Without following in anyone's footsteps,
this grand detour... is something only I could have made.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Mmh.
King-saaahn!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Are you playing around too, King-san?!
If you'd like, why don't we blast off together in those go-karts over there—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!?
Trainer-san, you're here together too!?
Could it be that the two of you are here on business...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
Shh! Shhh!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...*ahem*. Kawakami-san,
the truth is, I came to scout the venue for tomorrow's autograph session."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! King really is so dedicated to her work...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I just finished right now.
So, shall we play together?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer,
I grant you the privilege of entertaining us with all your might!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Isn't it your job to support me
with everything you've got at all times?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how long the detour,
you have always held my hand.
I expect nothing less than the finest escort from you this time, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu.
...Thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, King Halo played to her heart's content at the amusement park,
and at the autograph session held later, she carried out her duties as a king with flying colors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after a little while—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘Thank you for always taking care of my daughter.
There is one matter I'd like to ask you about.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""...Has the pattern she likes
not changed since she was a child?""

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer?
Is that call about another autograph session?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like I'll be tagging along on
this detour for a while longer.
